*.id: Stable project id (market code and number)

projects.name: Project name as marketed
projects.stage: Stage on record: off-plan, under construction, completed
projects.sales_status: Sales status when stated (active, sold out, stalled, website dead)
projects.permit_number: Permit or registration number when published
projects.handover_on_record: Handover date on record, as written in the source
projects.handover_month: handover_on_record as YYYY-MM (a quarter counts as its last month, a year as December)
projects.first_handover_on_record: First handover date we recorded, as written
projects.delay_months: Months between the first and the current date when the source states it
projects.price_min: Lowest asking price advertised (not a sale price)
projects.price_per_m2_min: price_min / size_min_m2 (only when the smallest size is 10 m2 or more)
projects.payment_plan: Payment plan as written in the source
projects.foreign_ownership: Ownership form for foreign buyers as written
projects.registered_company: Registered company named in the sources (text in brackets removed)
projects.lat: Pin latitude from official or developer sources
projects.dld_percent_built: Percent built at the last DLD inspection
projects.dld_completion_date: Completion date on the DLD register
projects.escrow_bank: Escrow bank on the DLD register
projects.dld_source: Where the DLD record was read
projects.claims_unverified: Claims no other source confirms yet
projects.record_sha256: SHA-256 of the project record as sealed

claims.claim: The claim as the developer or a portal states it
claims.checked_against: What it was checked against: official register, independent source, developer, not checked
claims.source: Link where the claim was read
claims.read: Date the project was last read or reviewed

markets.with_permit_number: Projects with a published permit or registration number
markets.with_handover_date: Projects with a handover date on record
markets.overdue: Projects whose handover date on record has passed and that are not completed
markets.median_price_per_m2_min: Median price_per_m2_min (3 or more projects; currencies mixed if the market uses more than one)
